mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (uid, email, password, nickname, avatar, ip_address, last_login_time, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uid}, #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{ipAddress}, #{lastLoginTime}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET password = #{password}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
